query:
SELECT 
  p.id, 
  p.title,
  p.slug,
  COUNT(pt.tagId) as tag_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(t.name SEPARATOR ', ') as tags
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
LEFT JOIN tags t ON pt.tagId = t.id
WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.discipline = 'scenic_design' AND p.featured = true
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.slug
ORDER BY tag_count ASC, p.year DESC;
